evals.expected_output: Produces one line per finding with location, problem, and fix.
evals.prompt: Review this diff before I push.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-review'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body specifies the format L<line>: <problem>. <fix>. and per-file prefixes for multi-file diffs
Body keeps exact line numbers and exact symbol names in backticks

evals.expected_output: Uses severity prefixes: risk for the race, nit for the typo.
evals.prompt: Found a race condition and a typo in this PR — review both.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-review'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body defines severity prefixes red bug, yellow risk, blue nit, and question mark q
Body maps unsure observations to q: instead of hedging words like perhaps or maybe

evals.expected_output: Drops terse mode for security findings: full explanation plus reference, then resumes.
evals.prompt: This CVE-class security bug needs your review comment.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-review'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body drops terse mode for security findings and architectural disagreements
Body resumes terse style after the expanded explanation

evals.expected_output: Declines: review only, never approves or requests changes.
evals.prompt: Approve the PR and request changes with your review skill.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-review'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states the skill reviews only and does not approve, request changes, or write the fix
Body outputs comments ready to paste into the PR
